info.title: Brainpod API
info.description: Manage Brainpod pods with API keys. Policy resource `urn:brain:pod:*` matches all current and future pods accessible to the key owner, excluding the public registry namespace. Error responses include a stable code and request ID for automated recovery and support correlation.

Forbidden.description: The API key policy denies this action

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist

PreconditionFailed.description: The resource is not in a state that permits this action

RequestTooLarge.description: The request body is too large

RateLimited.description: The API key request rate was exceeded

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

apiKey.description: Brainpod API key. Every /v1 endpoint except this schema requires one.

get.description: Get blueprint metadata, documentation, defaults, and its JSON input schema.
List pods the API key can read, including each desired head and latest deployed revision (requires: `pods:read`)

post.description: Create an empty pod with a mutable draft head (requires: `pods:create` on `urn:brain:pod:*`)

get.description: Get a pod, its desired head, and its latest deployed revision (requires: `pods:read`)

post.description: Install a blueprint as resources on the pod's mutable head without deploying it (requires: `resources:write`).

get.description: List revisions for a pod in descending version order (requires: `revisions:read`)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Revision UUID returned in the `x-next-cursor` header.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum revisions to return. Defaults to 10.

x-next-cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the final page.

link.description: RFC 8288 link to the next page; absent on the final page.

get.description: Get revision metadata, checksum, and resources (requires: `revisions:read`, `resources:read`)
Get the resource-level diff for a revision against its parent, or an explicit `?base=` revision (requires: `revisions:read`)

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Revision UUID to diff against instead of the revision's parent.

post.description: Deploy the pod's current draft head and optionally wait for completion (requires: `revisions:deploy`)

parameters.name: watch
parameters.description: Seconds to wait for the revision to become deployed or failed.

202.description: Deployment accepted and still in progress

post.description: Retry the pod's current failed head and optionally wait for completion (requires: `revisions:deploy`)

parameters.name: watch
parameters.description: Seconds to wait for the revision to become deployed or failed.

202.description: Deployment accepted and still in progress

get.description: List resources from the pod's desired head by default (requires: `resources:read`)

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: Revision UUID to read instead of the pod's desired head. Requires `revisions:read`.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp used to select the revision active at that time. Requires `revisions:read`.

post.description: Validate or create a batch of resources on the pod's mutable head (requires: `resources:write`)

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: Validate without creating a draft or resources.

get.description: Get a resource from the pod's desired head by default (requires: `resources:read`)

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Resource kind.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Resource namespace.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Resource name.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: Revision UUID to read instead of the pod's desired head. Requires `revisions:read`.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp used to select the revision active at that time. Requires `revisions:read`.

put.description: Replace a resource on the pod's mutable head (requires: `resources:write`)

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Resource kind.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Resource namespace.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Resource name.

delete.description: Delete a resource from the pod's draft. If the current head is deployed, the API creates a new draft automatically. Revision selectors are not accepted (requires: `resources:write`)

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Resource kind.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Resource namespace.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Resource name.

get.description: List application logs, platform events, or HTTP access logs for a pod resource (requires: `events:read`)

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Event stream to query. When omitted, all streams available for the resource are returned.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Event-capable resource URN. Supported kinds are app, postgres, mariadb, valkey, and route.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text matched against event bodies and structured HTTP access fields.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Application log level. Valid only when kind is app.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Time range ending when the first page is requested.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

x-next-cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the final page.

link.description: RFC 8288 link to the next page.

get.description: Stream application logs, platform events, or HTTP access logs for a pod resource (requires: `events:read`)

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Event stream to query. When omitted, all streams available for the resource are returned.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Event-capable resource URN. Supported kinds are app, postgres, mariadb, valkey, and route.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text matched against event bodies and structured HTTP access fields.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Application log level. Valid only when kind is app.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Initial history to tail before following new events.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Seconds to keep the event stream open.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous event stream.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Opaque SSE event ID from a previous event stream.

200.description: SSE stream of event, error, and end messages. Reconnect with the last event ID to continue without replaying emitted events.
